haltedAlert.title: {count} ticket is stopped | {count} tickets are stopped
haltedAlert.description: Tickets marked in red must not be worked on for now, until the stop is lifted directly on the ticket.

confirmDialog.title: Stop work on ticket?
confirmDialog.intro: You are about to request a work stop for {key}.
confirmDialog.whatHappens: What happens now: a stop message with your name appears in your project's Slack channel. The team is asked to stop working on this ticket immediately.
confirmDialog.untilWhen: How long this applies: the stop stays active until you lift it again in the dashboard. Only then may work resume.
confirmDialog.hint: Use this function when you want to check in before additional hours are billed. For tickets you are simply no longer interested in, use “Mute” instead.

toast.requestHaltSuccess: Work stop requested for {key}. The channel has been informed.
toast.requestHaltError: The stop could not be requested.
toast.resolveHaltSuccess: Work stop lifted for {key}. Work can resume.
toast.resolveHaltError: The stop could not be lifted.
toast.silenceSuccess: {key} permanently muted. No further Slack messages will be sent.
toast.unsilenceSuccess: Mute lifted for {key}. Slack messages are active again.
